title: Among patients diagnosed with SLE who have a normal albumin level, identify
question: Among patients diagnosed with SLE who have a normal albumin level, identify the oldest male patient and return his ID, sex, and whether his complement 4 (C4) level is within the normal range.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS Sex,
    CASE WHEN L."XCL_021" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS C4_Normal
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND L."XCL_031" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5
  AND P."XCL_059" = 'M'
ORDER BY P."XCL_060" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS Sex,
    CASE WHEN L."XCL_047" BETWEEN 10 AND 40 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS C4_Normal
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
